# every table must include repo_id (except repositories and llm_cache)

All tables declared on Base.metadata (except 'repositories' and 'llm_cache') must have a 'repo_id' column.

Maintain ADR-001 invariant that no schema decision may assume a single-repo; ensure multi-repo isolation/tracking at the row level.
